answer: Copying an answer therefore yields nothing, and producing 65 genuinely distinct answers per epoch is real inference work with real latency; the echo ledger keeps the similarity graph, and the nadir review can re-run it. Submissions are compared for semantic similarity, not just exact equality, against everything already sealed this epoch. A near-duplicate is rejected at the willow gate and the submitting identity is flagged, so one good text cannot be reused across aliases.
